content.text:
Shop doesn't sell ore (sale_price null, stock 0). So I need an ore from another miner. 小砾 is a miner at shop. Maybe she has ore. I have 12 coins; buy ore from her for maybe 4-5 coins? Repair costs 2 coins + ore. Then mine with fixed pickaxe: each mining = 2 AP, 1 ore, sells 3. 

Given AP=7 now. Path: shop -> smith 3 AP = 4 left. Repair at smith. Then smith->mine 3 AP = 1 AP left. Can't mine (2 AP). So this slot: repair only, next slot mine.

But unless 小砾 sells ore. Let's ask. Could send private message. Let's ask 小砾 if she has an ore to sell. But she's at the same location — messaging works anyway. Actually maybe I can talk via sending message. Let me do that. Also could gift coins and she gifts ore, but coordinating in one turn is tricky.

Alternatively mine without pickaxe? No.

Let me message 小砾: ask to sell 1 ore for 4 coins, or lend. Then move to smith.

Actually since we're co-located, the fastest: send message. She may respond later. But this turn likely single round. Let me be practical: send message to 小砾, and also maybe to 老铁 asking if repair can be done with 2 coins without ore? No, rules say needs ore.

Let me first ask 小砾. Then move to 铁匠铺 (3 AP) to at least be positioned. Hmm but if 小砾 replies I need to trade, being at same place helps. Actually gifts require same location? "当前可达" — probably fine.

Better: message 小砾 first, wait? There's no waiting tool. The turn ends when I finish. I can send messages and move. Perhaps messaging triggers her later this turn? NPCs act in their own turns. Simpler: ask 小砾 to sell ore; she may deliver next slot.

But maybe I should search memory for ore stock. Let me check my memory.

AP 4. I need ore. Options: ask 小砾 (she hasn't replied). Could maybe gather ore at mine? No pickaxe. 

Hmm, I have 2 AP left after nothing. Actually can I go to 矿坑 (3 AP) with 4? Yes to 3, leaving 1. But no pickaxe → can't mine.

Could I buy ore from 老铁? He said he'd buy ore, not sell. His inventory 0 ore.

Could wait for 小砾. Messaging her again? She may be another agent. Let me see if she has responded—no.

Alternative: maybe I could pick up ore at mine by hand? Rules: mining needs pickaxe. 

Given constraints, the sensible action: ask 老铁 to repair with ore he might source? No.

Perhaps borrow: 小砾 as a fellow miner likely has ore. Perhaps I should have stayed at shop to trade. I moved away. Hmm.

Maybe I can send a message to 小砾 asking her to come to the smith with ore, or send ore via gift (gift doesn't require same location, just reachable). If she gifts ore, then I can repair. But turn structure: each slot one round of actions and 10 AP. I've used 6 AP (10→4). Trading via message may happen next slot.

What's the best use of remaining 4 AP? I could return to shop (3 AP) to be co-located with 小砾 for a trade... but AP only 1 leftover, and next slot resets. Actually going to shop may enable personal interaction? All actions are tools though.

Wait—maybe 小砾 needs something from me. She's a miner. Let me also check whether there's an option to "borrow" ore... no.

Alternatively, mine gold without pickaxe? no.

Hmm, maybe I should just wait—but no wait tool. I could send a message and end the turn. But then I waste 4 AP. Movement doesn't carry over presumably.

Could go to 矿坑 now (3 AP) and be ready for next slot to mine—but pickaxe still broken. And ore needed to repair. So mine is useless until repaired.

Best: stay at smith, message 小砾 to send ore by gift (she can gift remotely), promising 5 coins in return. Actually I can preemptively send 5 coins to her? Risky. Better to propose and wait.

But maybe I can trade with a different approach: send message to 老铁 offering to work/IOU? NPC 老铁 wouldn't break rules.

Let me consider: could I find ore on the ground? Perhaps at mine there's loose ore? The mine action might allow "捡矿石"? Let me check mine's tools even though I'm not there—network_visit 矿坑.

content.text:
Mine has only movement tool for me (mining tool maybe hidden for miners? or requires pickaxe). 小砾 is at mine currently (visitors show 小砾), though earlier she was at shop. So she's mining with her pickaxe, will get ore.

I have 4 AP. Options:
1. Message 小砾 asking to gift ore; then end turn here at smith. Next slot she can gift, I repair then mine.
2. Go back to shop (3 AP) to meet her? She's at mine now.

Best: message 小砾 asking to send one ore via gift when she has one, and I'll pay five coins. Also maybe send 5 coins upfront? That is a risk but builds trust; NPCs likely honor. Hmm but if she doesn't send, I lose coins. I could send coins only upon receipt.

Also message 林 about ore price (3 coins at shop) — courtesy, cheap. And 老铁: say I'll bring ore.

Actually maybe use remaining AP to just stay and converse. But let me think whether repair is needed this turn: no ore. End turn at smith, repair next turn.

Could there be a "gift" from me to 老铁? no.

Let me send 小砾 a follow-up clarifying: 铁匠铺修镐要一矿石，我现在人在铁匠铺，你若有矿石，送来或托人捎来，我付五金币（送你金币）。Also she's a miner, maybe she'd rather sell at shop for 3, so 5 is generous.

Then reply to 林 (price 3 coins/ore) and to 老铁 (I'll come with ore).

That's 3 messages, no AP cost indicated (message ap null). Good.

Then end turn. Actually I still have 4 AP. Is there anything productive? Standing at smith with broken pickaxe, no ore — nothing. Could move to mine (3 AP) so next slot I'm there... but need repair first at smith. Staying at smith is right.

Send messages.

content.arguments: {"key": "ash-stone-buy-ore-2", "recipient": "小砾", "text": "小砾，我刚到铁匠铺问清楚了：修镐确实要两金币加一块矿石，我身上没矿石。你也是矿工，要是手头有富余的矿石，能不能先匀我一块？我付五金币，比商店回收价还高两块。你托人捎来、或者直接送我这儿都行，我人在铁匠铺等着。修好镐我就能下矿，回头也能帮你搭把手。", "topic": "买矿石"}

content.name: mod_2a4c4d023415836078eaf124
content.arguments: {"key": "ash-stone-reply-lin-1", "recipient": "林", "text": "林，早上好。商店收矿石是每块三金币，木材每根两金币，黄金每块十金币。不过柜台现在矿石库存是零，收了也是直接进柜台。我今天镐子坏了，正想法子修，行情就这些，你参考着来。", "topic": "矿石行情"}

content.name: mod_2a4c4d023415836078eaf124
content.arguments: {"key": "ash-stone-reply-tie-1", "recipient": "老铁", "text": "老铁，我是阿石，人就在你铺子门口。镐子确实坏了，修一把两金币加一矿石的价我认。只是眼下手里一块矿石也没有，正等矿上的小砾匀我一块。矿石一到我就来递给你，麻烦你炉子先别熄。", "topic": "修镐"}

data.name: mod_2a4c4d023415836078eaf124
data.arguments: {"key": "ash-stone-buy-ore-2", "recipient": "小砾", "text": "小砾，我刚到铁匠铺问清楚了：修镐确实要两金币加一块矿石，我身上没矿石。你也是矿工，要是手头有富余的矿石，能不能先匀我一块？我付五金币，比商店回收价还高两块。你托人捎来、或者直接送我这儿都行，我人在铁匠铺等着。修好镐我就能下矿，回头也能帮你搭把手。", "topic": "买矿石"}
